about_the_game:
Experience the opening chapter of Lumara in this free demo. Explore 4 handcrafted levels in a 20–30 minute journey that introduces core mechanics of light control, sprint, and physics-based interaction. Your descent ends with a cryptic message from the Guardians of the Deep…

Full Demo Description

This demo offers a first glimpse into the world of Lumara, giving you a focused slice of the experience:

  • Playtime: Around 20–30 minutes

  • Levels: 4 handcrafted stages that gradually expand the world’s atmosphere and introduce its challenges

  • Core Mechanics:

    • Movement and sprinting to navigate the depths

    • Light control to reveal paths and solve environmental challenges

    • Interaction with the physics-based environment for natural, immersive puzzles

  • Conclusion: The demo concludes with a mysterious encounter and a message from the Guardians of the Deep.

Supported in this demo:

  • Language: English only

  • Player mode: Single-player

  • Input: Keyboard and controller

This free demo is a standalone preview designed to let you experience the tone, mechanics, and atmosphere of Lumara’s opening journey.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10.13 High Sierra or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 Dual-Core @ 2.0 GHz or Apple M1
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics, AMD Radeon R9 M370X, or Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Quad-Core @ 2.7 GHz or Apple M1 / M2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 560 / Vega series, or Apple M1 Pro / M2 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard

short_description: Descend into a corrupted abyss as a lone anglerfish in this atmospheric puzzle-adventure. Solve physics-based puzzles, uncover forgotten knowledge, face mutated creatures, and use your light to push back shadows and restore what was lost.
